main.description: Beta query for raw account- and entity-follow records published by anyone, ordered by descending (createdAt, uri). Duplicate records are preserved and before is an exclusive upper bound on publisher-declared createdAt; these behaviors are provisional pending consumer confirmation. This is a recent-activity feed, not a lossless ingestion or backfill API; late-indexed records and concurrent changes may be missed across pages. Authentication is not required.

before.description: Exclusive upper bound on the follow record's publisher-declared createdAt, not indexedAt; omit to start with the newest indexed records. Keep unchanged across cursor pages.

limit.description: Maximum follow records per page; default 25.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; keep before unchanged. Pagination has no snapshot guarantee.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The before datetime, limit, cursor, or query parameter is invalid; use a valid datetime, limit of 1–100, or a cursor from this query.

recentFollowView.description: Raw indexed account- or entity-follow record with its publishing repository identity. The unchanged record's $type distinguishes the follow collection.

cid.description: CID of the indexed follow record version.

indexedAt.description: Time this follow record was indexed, not the ordering field.

did.description: DID of the repository that published this follow record.

record.description: Unmodified account- or entity-follow record; its $type identifies the collection.

follows.description: Raw follow records from both collections, sorted by createdAt descending then URI descending, including duplicates.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when no further page exists.
